statement: A proprietary company must have at least 1 director, and that director must ordinarily reside in Australia; a public company must have at least 3 directors (not counting alternates), at least 2 of whom ordinarily reside in Australia.
caveat: A proprietary company with crowd-sourced-funding shareholders needs at least 2 directors with the residency mix in section 201A(1A). Only individuals aged 18 or over may be appointed (section 201B), and appointees need a director identification number first (section 1272C).
